name: MATCH
description: MATCH searches for a specified item in a range and returns its relative position.
tldr: MATCH finds the position of a value in a range.

basicExample.explanation: Returns the position (3) where "Apple" is found in the range.

advancedExamples.title: MATCH with INDEX for two-way lookup
advancedExamples.description: Combine MATCH with INDEX for flexible lookups
advancedExamples.explanation: MATCH finds the row position, INDEX retrieves the value.

howItWorks: MATCH scans the lookup_array for the lookup_value and returns its relative position (1-based).

howToSteps.name: Define value
howToSteps.text: Determine the value to search for.

howToSteps.name: Select range
howToSteps.text: Choose the range to search within.

limitations: MATCH returns position, not the actual value.
For returning the value, combine with INDEX.

commonErrors.fix: Check that the value exists in the lookup range.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: MATCH works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Is MATCH case-sensitive?
faq.answer: No, MATCH is not case-sensitive by default.

faq.question: Can MATCH search horizontally?
faq.answer: Yes, MATCH works with horizontal ranges as well.
